items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: But I was very well acquainted with George Bakke. Sure. ... I knew all of his people.

ctx.x: Do you remember the High Society chorus? Who was the first one you ever heard play that little runs? You remember that?

Well, I'm going to give you the full definition of that. That was asked to me in a National Jazz meeting at 831 Caronelet Street in the year of 1949. I believe it was 40, 80 held that meeting at 831 Caronelet Street. People were all over. That same group came out to my place that very second or third night after they held that meeting. They came out to the happy land and while I was playing, sat down and had a nice time that night. They brought that same question up. They brought that same question up. See, who…
Was George Bakke playing with you?
